races.paceDynamic: Mollys Dolly is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will dictate proceedings from the outset. With no other natural pace angles, she'll be allowed to bowl along at a comfortable tempo through the early stages without pressure. The large field of hold-up horses will settle in behind, creating a cavalry charge scenario in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick early, as the sheer volume of hold-up horses will create traffic problems and leave many with too much to do.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested leader holds
scenarios.trigger: If Mollys Dolly gets an easy lead and stays on
scenarios.body: Her soft early pace preserves stamina for the finish while the pack behind comes too late. The front runner's tactical advantage proves decisive against a wall of hold-up horses who meet traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Quality prevails late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The highest-rated horses Hunskelper and Dromana Mist find clear runs and their class tells in the final furlong. Superior ability overcomes tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tracker strikes perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If a horse settles handy and times run perfectly
scenarios.body: A prominent runner like Dictionary Corner or one that improves position early gets first run on the field. They avoid the traffic chaos while having enough pace to reel in Mollys Dolly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites disappoint or meet trouble
scenarios.body: Fitness doubts and tactical problems open the door for an improving type. Form horses fail to fire leaving the race open for a surprise package.

races.paceDynamic: Crystal Gold will likely take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a manageable gallop without serious early pressure. Two Pair, Miss Lia, Joshua's Daylami, Kimy, Lily Milan and Last Note will track in prominent positions, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Born Bright, Simple Things, One Night Standard and Roxhill Roise will look to time their runs from off the pace. With only one natural leader and plenty of hold-up types, this sets up as a tactical affair that will strongly favour the prominent runners who can track Crystal Gold's lead and have first run on the patient types.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Crystal Gold sets reasonable fractions and the prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The pace will be controlled enough for those tracking to outkick the hold-up horses who get caught flat-footed. Two Pair and Miss Lia are best placed to capitalise with Sean Flanagan and proven tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Times It
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and allows back markers time to wind up
scenarios.body: Born Bright or Simple Things could unleash devastating late runs if given enough rope by a crawling pace. Their class advantage tells when they get the right setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Crystal Gold Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Crystal Gold gets soft fractions and maintains her jumping rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: She'll prove hard to peg back if allowed to dictate terms unchallenged, particularly given her front-running style suits this trip. The 41-day break could have her spot-on fresh.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses converge on Crystal Gold early and create unexpected pressure
scenarios.body: A scrambling finish develops where any horse with a clear run can prevail regardless of style. Form horses like Malikanna or Fair Damsel could sneak through the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: Mo Ghille Mar represents the sole confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner field, likely to dictate terms from the outset without serious early pressure. Deise Crystal, Garrick Painter and Bohemian Bay may track close but prefer prominent rather than lead roles. The large field and sustainable early gallop will create a tactical affair with the real racing beginning from three out. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late acceleration, as the lack of genuine pace pressure will leave plenty in reserve for those positioned to strike late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Late Surge Decides
scenarios.trigger: If Mo Ghille Mar sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows closers to conserve energy before unleashing finishing kicks in the final half-mile. Hold-up specialists with proven acceleration can exploit the tactical nature and soft early splits.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front End Holds Firm
scenarios.trigger: If Mo Ghille Mar maintains a strong gallop and the prominent runners cannot match his stamina
scenarios.body: The leader's class advantage and tactical position prove decisive when challenges arrive from three out. Those tracking the pace early struggle to find the extra gear needed in testing ground conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midrace Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens dramatically from halfway as prominent runners jostle for position
scenarios.body: The race develops into a stamina test that finds out the weaker elements in the large field. Horses with recent form and fitness advantages can capitalise when others weaken approaching the final flight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Factor
scenarios.trigger: If fallers or interference disrupt the flow in a bunched field over the final three flights
scenarios.body: The large field and competitive nature create traffic problems that favour those drawn wider or held up out of trouble. Luck in running becomes the decisive factor rather than pure ability.

races.paceDynamic: Fedneys Park will make the running from flagfall with little early pressure in this 17-runner handicap hurdle. The prominent runners Butch Coolidge, Final Decision, Menas Miracle and Craic Eile will sit handy but won't hassle the leader early. With 12 hold-up horses in the field and Fedneys Park's tendency to fade in the finish, the pace will be steady early before quickening from the second-last hurdle. This tactical setup strongly favours the hold-up brigade who can produce late finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Fedneys Park sets moderate fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up horses will have plenty left for a sustained drive from the back. Gamigin, Bossing It and Western Opera can unleash finishing kicks that the pace-setters cannot match.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely steady and prominent runners conserve energy
scenarios.body: Final Decision and Menas Miracle can kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized. Their forward positions allow them to dictate when the real race begins.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fedneys Park Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Fedneys Park gets easy lead fractions and avoids his usual fade
scenarios.body: The Henry De Bromhead runner can steal sufficient advantage to hold off late challenges. His class edge at OR 100 proves decisive in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where any horse with a clear run can strike. Lightweights like Esticky End and Cholo can spring surprises at big prices.

races.paceDynamic: Jackmoon will dictate from the front with minimal early pressure, likely joined by Jetaway Nana, Krishna Bellevue, Whatsavailable, Keep Em Quite and Dalmatic in the prominent positions behind. The large field of 17 means the pace won't be breakneck early, but with several prominent runners the tempo will be solid throughout the 3-mile trip on testing ground. This sets up perfectly for hold-up horses to deliver late kicks, as the combination of steady pace, stamina-sapping distance and soft ground will favour those conserving energy early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady without burning out the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The testing ground and 3-mile distance will drain the early leaders, allowing fresh closers to sweep past in the final half-mile. Multiple hold-up horses can finish strongly when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Jetaway Nana or Krishna Bellevue can track Jackmoon without over-racing
scenarios.body: The prominent runners maintain their positions into the straight and have enough left to hold off late challenges on ground that isn't quite testing enough. Experience of racing prominently pays dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Jackmoon Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Jackmoon gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The front-runner controls the race from start to finish, quickening at the right moments to stay clear of late challengers. Soft ground helps stamina types who can maintain rhythm.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where positioning and a turn of foot matter more than stamina. Horses with higher cruising speed can capitalise on the lack of early pace.

races.paceDynamic: Workahead will take the field along from the front, with Ma Jacks Hill and Chosen Shant likely to settle just off the pace in second and third. With only one confirmed front runner, Workahead can dictate proceedings without early pressure, creating a controlled tempo that suits his style. The hold-up horses - Supersundae, Wild Bill Hickok, and Reiki Revolution - will need the leaders to maintain a solid gallop to bring their finishing kicks into play. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those who can track the pace, as they'll be ideally positioned when the tempo inevitably quickens entering the home straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Workahead and Ma Jacks Hill maintain a steady but unrelenting gallop without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The two pace-tracking horses can kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets into gear. Supersundae and Wild Bill Hickok need a stronger tempo to unleash their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly run and the race develops into a staying test over the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Supersundae's superior class rating (OR 140) and Townend's tactical nous allow them to reel in the leaders despite the unfavourable early positioning. Wild Bill Hickok's recent Wexford win gives him confidence to challenge strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fresh Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Reiki Revolution's 147-day break proves beneficial rather than detrimental and he's produced with a well-timed challenge
scenarios.body: Cromwell's charge arrives on the scene full of running while others tire, making use of his excellent going record on similar surfaces. The long absence could have him primed for a peak effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Workahead goes too fast early under pressure from the prominent runners and the tempo becomes unsustainable
scenarios.body: The race falls apart completely, allowing any horse with stamina reserves to pick up the pieces in a messy finish. This chaotic scenario opens the door for the outsiders to capitalise on the front-runners' mistakes.

The three confirmed front runners will stretch the field early, creating a searching pace that will test stamina reserves thoroughly. With such pace guaranteed, horses needing cover and a strong finish will get the perfect setup to unleash late runs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and back-markers who can quicken off the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners go too hard early and fade from 2 out
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop set by Tell Nobody Nothin, Ceroc and Hit The Frame cracks the leaders, allowing fresh hold-up horses to sweep past. Favori Logique and Mount Shenshan benefit most from the collapse with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters has enough left after setting strong fractions
scenarios.body: Tell Nobody Nothin or Hit The Frame proves tough enough to withstand their own early pressure and holds on grimly. The winner comes from the leading group who dictated throughout the contest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Pack Momentum
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but not suicidal, allowing prominent racers to strike
scenarios.body: Riggs and Plain Or Battered get the perfect trip tracking the leaders without doing the donkey work. They launch decisive moves approaching the last two fences while others are stopping.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners go steady early, negating the stamina test
scenarios.body: The three natural leaders surprisingly restrain themselves, creating a sprint finish that suits different profiles. One Horse Army's class tells in a muddling contest that lacks the expected pace.

watchPoints.text: Tell Nobody Nothin and Ceroc could set unsustainable fractions if they engage in early battle for the lead
Riggs returns from 260-day absence carrying top weight - watch for signs of rustiness or lack of match fitness
Mount Shenshan has been running well in defeat recently and the Mullins team may have found the right opportunity
One Horse Army needs to overcome both poor recent form and the burden of a 7lb claiming jockey in this competitive heat
Watch the early pace - if the three front runners restrain themselves it completely changes the complexion of the finish
